explanation: The UAV collided with a static obstacle at 8.3 seconds, resulting in a minimum clearance of -0.05 meters. The failure was caused by a combination of environmental factors, including a 1.1 m/s headwind and sensor noise, alongside the late appearance of the obstacle at 6.4 seconds. Counterfactual analysis confirms that reducing UAV speed, removing wind or noise, or re-seeding the planner would have prevented the collision.
